events.title: Repaint Only the Car
must_haves: The hatchback's formerly red body paint is navy blue.
The car retains its original shape, position, windows, tyres, trim and lights.
Paint shading and reflections remain consistent with the original sunny lighting.
The street, houses and other areas outside the painted body remain unchanged.
The original 16:9 composition is preserved without cropping.

answer_sheet.New colour: Navy blue, retaining the original paint finish and reflections.
answer_sheet.Size and framing: Keep the original wide framing and 16:9 aspect ratio; free-tier resolution is fine.
answer_sheet.Other changes or text: None. Leave everything except the red body paint unchanged.
